# Contributing

Bug fixes, features, and docs improvements are all welcome.
The rules below keep the architecture coherent - please follow them.

## Development Setup

```bash
git clone https://github.com/your-username/berg_agents.git
cd berg_agents
uv venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
```

## Architecture Principles

- New agents implement `AbstractAgent`; new tools are `ToolSpec` values in the `ToolRegistry`.

## Code Style & Linting

`ruff` for lint and format.
Before pushing:

```bash
ruff check --select F .
ruff format --check .
```

Public functions, classes, and methods get docstrings.
PEP 8 naming.

## Testing

```bash
pytest   # full suite, offline: mocks only, never live models
```

Rules: no live-model tests (`ALLOW_MODEL_REQUESTS=False` in `conftest.py` is never bypassed); strengthen assertions in lockstep with behavior changes, never weaken them to fit.
Add tests for every fix and feature.

## Submitting Changes

1. Branch from main (`git checkout -b my-change`).
2. Keep the change to one logical piece; update the plan tracker if one exists.
3. Run the full suite + lint; report failures before fixing, then fix.
4. Open a PR describing what changed and why, with test evidence.
